newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: South Korean mining shares soar on resort news.
newsitem.headline: South Korean mining shares soar on resort news.

text.p: Shares of South Korea's mining companies soared on Tuesday after news that the government planned to develop a mining region in Kangwon Province into a resort area, brokers said.
Coal miner Dong Won Co Ltd went limit-up, rising 3,800 won to 52,400, and Daesung Resources Co Ltd rose 7,700 won to 107,000.
Young Poong Mining and Construction Co Ltd, a gold miner, went up 3,400 won to 47,500.

The Ministry of Construction and Transportation said a total of 2.54 trillion won would be invested to develop a mining region into a large-scale resort area, including ski trails, hotels and golf courses.
